### Wisdom from the Psalms 8/4
Author: Crosswalk.com
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/wisdom/wisdom-from-the-psalms-8-or-4-552488.html
Passage: Psalm 99:9
Points:
- Sacred spaces and intentional moments help remind believers of the awe of God's presence.
- Christians too often live with spiritual apathy, treating God as if He were ordinary.
- Neglected prayer, skipped gatherings, and missed opportunities to share faith reveal a lack of reverence.
- The Lord is supreme, and every aspect of daily life should exalt His holiness.
